description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of FOCUS values across different political leanings, categorized as Left bias, Left center bias, Quest. source, and Right bias. The horizontal axis represents the political leanings, while the vertical axis, labeled as FOCUS, ranges from 0.0 to 1.0. Each bar is segmented into three colors representing different narrative roles: HERO (blue), VICTIM (brown), and VILLAIN (light blue). The HERO segment is consistently the largest in all categories, indicating a higher FOCUS value for heroes across all political leanings. The VICTIM segment is the second largest, followed by the VILLAIN segment, which is the smallest in each category. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
